hints.title: Associative and Commutative Addition
hints.text: Since the only operator present is addition "+", order of evaluation does not change the multiset of leaf variable values.

hints.title: Leaf Frequency Counting
hints.text: Collect the frequency of every variable letter across all leaves of both trees.

hints.title: Multiset Equality Verification
hints.text: Two expression trees are equivalent if and only if their leaf variable frequency distributions are identical.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from collections import Counter

class Solution:
    def checkEquivalence(self, root1: 'Node', root2: 'Node') -> bool:
        def count_leaves(node, counter):
            if not node:
                return
            if node.val != '+':
                counter[node.val] += 1
            count_leaves(node.left, counter)
            count_leaves(node.right, counter)
        c1 = Counter()
        c2 = Counter()
        count_leaves(root1, c1)
        count_leaves(root2, c2)
        return c1 == c2
```

variables: N1, N2: number of nodes in each expression tree
complexity.notes: Traverses each tree in linear time to count leaf frequencies across the 26 lowercase English letters.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing tree structures directly fails because associativity allows different tree shapes to represent identical sums.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting leaf multiset frequencies ignores tree shape and verifies commutativity directly.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizing additive commutativity and comparing multiset leaf counts.
